configuration.csmModules.defaultModuleRo: Default relative directory used when initializing local CSM module management for a repository that does not already have a csm-modules.yaml file.
configuration.csmModules.hiddenTopics.de: Module repository topics to hide from the CSM Modules sidebar badges, tree tooltips, and local search text.
configuration.csmModules.autoStarCsmCore: Automatically star the CSM Core repository (NEVSTOP-LAB/Communicable-State-Machine) on GitHub when applying modules to the local workspace.
configuration.csmModules.autoStarModuleR: Automatically star the downloaded module repository on GitHub when applying it to the local workspace.
configuration.csmModules.hideArchivedRep: Hide archived module repositories from the Available Modules list. When disabled, archived repositories are shown alongside active ones.
configuration.csmModules.forkedReposHand: Control how forked module repositories appear in the list.
Exclude all forked repositories (show only original repos).
Keep only the most recently pushed version per repository name.
configuration.csmModules.hiddenOwners.de: Owners whose repositories should be hidden from the Available Modules list (case-insensitive).
configuration.csmModules.filterTopics.de: Repositories containing any of these topics will be hidden from the Available Modules list (case-insensitive).
configuration.csmlog.folding.enabled.des: Enable folding of repeated log lines in CSMLog files.
configuration.csmlog.folding.minRepeatCo: Minimum number of consecutive identical (or similar) lines before they are folded into a repeat region.
configuration.csmlog.folding.maxBlockLin: Maximum number of lines in a block pattern to detect for multi-line repeating blocks.
configuration.csmlog.folding.smartParams: When enabled, lines with the same message template but different parameter values are folded together (e.g. 'Try to Connect >> {localhost;6340;1}' and '… >> {localhost;6340;2}').
configuration.csmlog.folding.decorationS: Controls the information shown on folded repeat regions.
Show repeat count, time span and rate (e.g. '…重复 42 次 · 12:26:15~12:26:26 · ≈4.2条/s').
